corrections.text: Corrected, 11 November 2026: on 10 November this page's header read 'computed 2026-11-09' and its footer 'computed 2026-11-10 05:03'. The first date was the last completed session, not the computation. The header and the attribution line now name the last completed close, for example 'as of the 2026-11-10 close', and the computed time appears once, in the footer. What was right as published: every level and change.
corrections.short: corrected 11 Nov: header date is the last completed close, not the computation time

corrections.text: Method changed, 10 November 2026: the indices are now built on each exchange's own dates, from completed sessions only. A bar from a session still open is dropped, and the headline date is the latest day on which at least 18 of 20 constituents have a completed bar. Before this, Hong Kong and Tokyo bars could sit a day ahead of Europe and New York in the same point. On the old build the CC20 fell 6.4% on 5 November; on the new build that step is 3.1%. Levels and changes printed before 10 November were on the old build.
corrections.short: method changed 10 Nov: completed sessions only, exchange-local dates; see indices.html

corrections.text: Corrected, 9 November 2026: on 8 November this page and the homepage price desk printed a 1D change of +0.00% for all five indices. The newest point in the series was dated Sunday 8 November, created when one constituent printed a bar stamped that day, so the 1D compared Friday's values with themselves. It was not a session move. The 1D is now withheld whenever the newest point falls on a weekend. What was right as published: the index levels.
corrections.short: corrected 9 Nov: the 8 Nov 1D of +0.00% was a Sunday-dated point, not a session; see indices.html
